# Documentation Authority and Release Boundary

## Purpose

The manual will explain shared calculations and interchange contracts from
theory and assumptions through typed inputs, units, coordinate and time
conventions, algorithms, implementation symbols, tests, uncertainty,
limitations, consumer surfaces, and artifacts. Tools source and evidence remain
authoritative; the manual cannot approve a calculation that its owning source,
evidence, license, or human review has not approved.

## Canonical Source

Only QMD under `manuals/tools` is editable manual source. Existing user guides,
ADRs, package documentation, generated API references, and publications are
separate governed products. They can supply reviewed references, but none is a
second mutable source for this manual.

Generated LaTeX, PDF, DOCX, and HTML are non-editable artifacts. A correction
starts in canonical QMD, then regenerates every affected representation through
the qualified toolchain. TOOLS-D2 owns that toolchain; TOOLS-D7 and TOOLS-D8
own artifact review and publication evidence.

## Evidence and License Classes

Every calculation and claim must be classified as observed, derived,
model-scenario, external, provisional, unavailable, or approved within an
explicit scope. Every borrowed source and generated artifact must preserve its
license and attribution. Content from Tools_Private or another non-public
source may not enter this public manual without explicit public authority.

## Approval and Failure Semantics

The default is deny-until-approved. Missing inventory coverage, source
authority, units, coordinate or time convention, implementation symbol, test,
validity range, uncertainty, license, artifact digest, page review,
accessibility review, or human approval keeps the affected item blocked.
Unsupported values are never replaced with synthetic or plausible values
without an explicit model-scenario contract.

## Exemptions

Freshness failures are release-blocking. The TOOLS-D1 module baseline is
recomputed from tracked implementation and governed configuration files by
`python -m scripts.build_tools_module_inventory --check`; later TOOLS-D6 work
must extend freshness from the file baseline to stable calculation pathways.
Future exemptions must be structured, narrowly scoped, justified,
owned, reviewed, and expiring. An exemption cannot authorize an equation,
scientific claim, artifact, operating use, license transfer, or public
projection.

## Current Boundary

TOOLS-D1 establishes a complete file-level denominator for its declared tracked
scope. TOOLS-D2 establishes deterministic byte reproduction and governed
semantic preservation across HTML, LaTeX, PDF, and DOCX. Its generated
artifacts remain non-editable and unapproved. The conservative inventory does
not establish stable calculation identity, equation correctness, validity
ranges, uncertainty, page/accessibility approval, or publication authority.
TOOLS-D4 registers one model-conditioned D-plane exemplar with explicit
equation-to-code-to-test evidence while retaining review-required inventory
authority. The markerless-mocap exemplar remains fail-closed because its source
dependency is unmerged. Expansion, executable freshness, review, publication,
and human approval remain blocked under TOOLS-D5 through TOOLS-D9.
